properties.body:
EASTERN NORTH ATLANTIC.
SEA OF THE HEBRIDES.
SCOTLAND-WEST COAST.
DNC 19.
1. SURVEY OPERATIONS IN PROGRESS UNTIL 072359Z OCT
   BY EIGHT WAVE GLIDERS IN AREA BETWEEN
   56-00N 57-00N AND 007-00W 010-00W.

2. CANCEL THIS MSG 080059Z OCT 16.
